notes: Performance: Map Hack no longer drags D2R down. Monster scanning went from ~39,600 memory reads per second to ~7,500 on a busy map (about 5x lighter) with identical results. Monster scanning is skipped when all monster types are hidden; objects/shrines/portals refresh on their own slower rate; the health guard reads your character once per tick instead of three times; the belt check runs when you drink rather than on a blind 5s timer.
